transcript:
Joe: Fair warning, Marta asked the team to look at Siemens Opcenter as well. They've got an existing Teamcenter footprint so procurement likes the idea of one throat to choke.
Us: Understood. Where are they in that evaluation?
Joe: Early. No demo yet.
Us: And on our side, what happens after Marta says yes?
Joe: It goes to Ruth in procurement. She'll want the security questionnaire back, then legal do the MSA — that's typically six weeks with our lot, sometimes eight. Ruth is not obstructive, she's just got a queue.
Us: So realistically signature is mid-March.
Joe: If the questionnaire goes back this week, yes.
